previous_format: Drizzle & Pudge (kids cartoon) - scripts archived in channels/drizzlepudge/archive/
tagline: Every story has a twist. Every story has a lesson.
format: Story arcs: one topic per arc, 6 parts of ~80 s (10 shots x 8 s) released daily, then the full movie (all parts + title and moral cards, ~8.5 min, mid-roll eligible) 24 h after the finale. Hook line first, a 3 s 'previously' flash from part 2, scene-change transitions, a freeze-frame cliffhanger with a question, and the moral card in the finale.
style_prompt: cinematic photoreal film still, shot on a digital cinema camera with anamorphic lenses, shallow depth of field, motivated practical lighting, rich true-to-life dark skin tones, warm amber highlights and soft teal shadows, gentle atmospheric haze, premium drama series look, vertical 9:16 composition, subject centred, no text, no subtitles, no watermark
audio_prompt: clear natural dialogue in natural Nigerian English, never exaggerated, realistic room tone and subtle Foley sound effects, no background music (music is added in post)
negative_prompt: text, subtitles, captions, watermark, logo, cartoon, distorted faces, extra fingers, caricature, children
ai_disclosure: Fictional story. All characters are AI-generated; any resemblance to real people is coincidental.
content_rules: Fictional adults only. Dignified, modern, aspirational Nigerian settings and natural Nigerian English.
Never caricature: no scam plots, no mocking accents, tribes or religion, no poverty played as a joke.
Each arc: 6 parts x 10 shots x 8 s. Part 1 opens on the most explosive line. Parts 1-5 end on a freeze-frame cliffhanger + question card; part 6 resolves and ends on the moral card.
One fixed outfit and one fixed voice description per character for the whole arc (consistency).
<= 2 speakers per shot, <= 20 words per 8 s shot. Transitions only at scene changes (dip or flash).
No children on screen (the video model blocks minors; mention them off-screen only).
